title: Roots Reggae
tagline: Righteous rhythm, spoken lyric and a deep sense of place.
summary: Roots reggae grows from Jamaican folk, church and rhythm traditions and gives them a strong political and spiritual frame. It foregrounds the drum, the bass and the voice in a way that is both rhythmic and reflective. The sound can feel relaxed and steady, but it carries a direct sense of intent.

pillars.name: Bob Marley
pillars.why: Bob Marley made roots reggae widely legible, pairing deep lyrical intent with irresistible rhythm.

pillars.name: Peter Tosh
pillars.why: Peter Tosh gave the form a fiercer political edge and a strong, open-hearted sense of conviction.

pillars.name: Burning Spear
pillars.why: Burning Spear brought a devotional, rhythmic gravity to roots reggae that still feels foundational.
